subject.name: Talent Flow
subject.description: Movement detection engine for executive slot changes. Reads Process 200 LinkedIn snapshots month-over-month, detects CEO/CFO/HR movement, emits deterministic TF-01/TF-02 signals to signal_output. Pure database diff — no AI, no external APIs.

scope: Validate the 500-talent-flow PROCESS.md against the unified template structure (14 sections across 3 clusters: Identity/Contract/Governance) and the US-derived invariant set (10 comparators across 24 layers). Assess structural completeness — does every layer in the invariant set have a corresponding, non-empty section in the process document? Identify gaps, missing sections, and structural deviations. The operator intent references 'v6.0.0' but the current unified template in the codebase is v1.0.0 and the process claims template v3.0.0 — the version label is a tracking discrepancy, not a structural ambiguity. The invariant set from the US handoff defines the actual structural requirements. Grid Reader requirements refer to the pattern established in Process 100 (LCS Pipeline) — 500 is a spoke that feeds 100, so its output schema must be Grid Reader compatible (signals written to signal_output with outreach_id as join key).
